0022600169.text: The Trail Blazers (4-1, 3-0 on the road, first in the Northwest and third in the West) visit the Nuggets (3-2, fourth in the Northwest and one game back, ninth in the West) in Portland's sixth game of the season, with both teams having played five games so far. Portland is without Ja Morant (out, hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (out, knee surgery), while Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (out, personal), Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (out, hamstring). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Trail Blazers lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 137-132 loss in Denver on April 6, 2026.
